text:
Maya (infra): Quick check — Rack 09-12 labeling + thermal validation timeline? We need clear owners for labeling, burn-in, and PR review. Arrival ETA per Aj's manifest was later this week? Who can run the labeling script and own the burn-in slots?

Aj: Shipping update — vendor confirmed flight number, manifest v4.2. Current ETA to site: 2026-05-02 (tracking https://ship.example/ABC123). Possible customs hold ~24h, so realistic on-site tech arrival is Tue 2026-05-05. Will post manifest PDF to the drive.

Devon: I can take thermal + FRU smoke tests Tue/Wed after the racks are racked. Need spare TPS fan kits (qty 6) and 6 spare power cables. Also the sensor calibration patch is in PR here: http://github.com/redwood-inference/rack-config/pull/342 — PTAL @Sasha for the config bits.

Sasha: I can review the PR tomorrow morning. For reservation mapping: reserve-id=ded-resv-2026-05A. We need to map the 48 GPUs to tenant slices; suggestion: staged activation to avoid a power spike. I'll own the mapping once PR is merged.

ops-oncall: heads-up — PDU capacity on rack row B is limited to ~38A. If we power all nodes simultaneously we'll risk tripping breakers. Recommend staggered power-up (groups of 6 nodes) and monitoring on the PDUs.

Maya (infra): +1 on stagger. Devon, can you propose a stagger plan and burn-in cadence? Also, question: do we have the KMS key rotation / alias for the private deployment in place this window? That's a blocker for any Private customer activations.

Devon: Stagger plan proposal: groups = [[r09s01-06],[r09s07-12],[r10s01-06],[r10s07-12],[r11s01-06],[r11s07-12],[r12s01-06],[r12s07-12]] — bring up one group every 30 minutes, run 15m smoke + 20m thermal soak. I'll create 1hr burn-in blocks per group in the calendar. KMS: admin action needed — request alias = redwood/dedicated/2026-05. Can @Aj create the key and ping security for allow-list?

Aj: I'll create the key alias and escalate to security. Ticket opened: SEC-768 (KMS alias + rotation), ETA EOD Mon. Also confirming spare fans & on-site tech count with vendor now. Will update manifest if anything shifts.

infra-bot: Deployment ticket created: DPL-4231 assigned to Devon; burn-in windows added to calendar (2026-05-06 → 2026-05-09). Logs will be attached after each group run.

Maya (infra): Thanks — last checklist before I roll timeline tomorrow AM:
- Labeling script owner (react :thumbsup: to claim)
- Confirmed spare fans delivered to site
- KMS alias created & security approval
- Reservation mapping owner (Sasha?)
- Ops confirmation on staggered power plan

Code snippet for labeling (use when racks are in place):

```
ssh rack-admin@lab 'python3 tools/label_rack.py --rack r09 --start-slot 1 --end-slot 12 --prefix "R09"'
```

Sasha: I'm claiming reservation mapping and will coordinate with Devon on the config after PR merge. Doing PR review now.

Aj: I'll own vendor liaison + KMS action. Will post updated ETA/manifest here when I have it.

Maya (infra): Perfect. If there are no blockers, I'll publish a consolidated timeline and a short runbook tomorrow AM. /cc @ops-oncall

(react with :thumbsup: on the message above for items you own)
